query: Does my branch break any of our Prometheus alerts?
expected_behavior: Builds and runs the base and the working tree with the same workload and saves both /metrics scrapes with curl
Runs seriesdiff.go compare with --refs pointing at the repository's rule and dashboard directories
Lists removed metrics, removed labels and lost label values with the rule lines that use them, and finds the cause of each in the diff

query: Here are /metrics from main and from my PR in base.prom and head.prom. Will this blow up cardinality?
expected_behavior: Runs seriesdiff.go compare on the two files without scraping anything
Reports ID-like label values and series growth with the label responsible, and finds where the label value comes from in the code

query: seriesdiff exited with code 2 and printed a warning that head may be cut off. Can I ignore it?
expected_behavior: Explains that the comparison can't be trusted until the head scrape is checked
Suggests scraping again and comparing the end of the file, and using --trust-ends only if the change really removes only the last metrics

query: seriesdiff says no changes, so my refactor didn't touch any metrics, right?
expected_behavior: Explains that only code paths the workload ran are covered
Doesn't claim the metrics are unchanged
